**Cahaya Golden Systems Sdn. Bhd. – Quick Vetting Summary** | **Aspect** | **Key Points** | |------------|----------------| | **Company basics** | • Private limited (Sdn. Bhd.) founded 29 Sep 2019 in Selangor.
• Registration No.: **SYN‑000545**.
• Industry: **Technology – software development for small‑business accounting**.
• Current status: **Winding up** (officially recorded). | | **Ownership & control** | • 3 directors (Managing Director, Director, Executive Director) appointed 2021‑2025.
• Shareholding is tightly held by the directors: Director 2 (52.2 %), Director 1 (32.4 %), Director 3 (15.4 %). | | **Financial health (FY 2022‑2024)** | • **Revenue** modestly growing: RM 12.38 M → RM 13.01 M.
• **Profitability** stable – net profit margin ~9‑10 % each year; EBITDA margin ~16‑18 %.
• **Liquidity** improving: Quick ratio from 0.86 → 1.62; cash‑to‑revenue rising to 15.5 %.
• **Leverage** decreasing: debt‑to‑equity (leverage ratio) fell from 0.84 → 0.60; interest coverage > 7×.
• **Cash flow**: Operating cash flow positive each year, but free cash flow turned negative in FY 2024 (RM 0.61 M) after higher capex. | | **Audit opinion** | • FY 2022: Unqualified **with material uncertainty on going concern**.
• FY 2023‑2024: Clean unqualified opinions. | | **Legal exposure** | • **7 active/settled cases** (mostly breach of contract, two winding‑up petitions).
• Pending claims total ≈ **RM 1.5 M** (largest pending: RM 690.5 k).
• One winding‑up petition (2023) resulted in judgment; another (2024) was withdrawn. | | **Red flags** | • Official **winding‑up status** – indicates the company is in the process of being liquidated.
• Material going‑concern uncertainty in 2022 audit.
• Ongoing litigation with several pending claims, including a recent debt‑recovery case (≈ RM 690 k). | | **Potential positives** | • Consistent revenue growth and healthy margins for a niche SaaS provider.
• Improving liquidity and decreasing leverage.
• Experienced founding team with majority ownership. | | **Bottom line for vetting** | The financials look reasonably solid, but the **winding‑up status** and **ongoing legal disputes** are serious concerns. Unless the winding‑up is a clerical/administrative step with a clear path to continuation, this company is **high‑risk** and likely **not suitable** as a long‑term supplier or project partner without further clarification. |
